exposure: receipt of 17a-hydroxyprogesterone caproate within 7 days of delivery
cohort: The study participants were 221 women who were receiving 17a-hydroxyprogesterone caproate for preterm birth prevention and delivered between 2010 and 2014.
finding: Recent receipt of 17a-hydroxyprogesterone caproate for prevention of recurrent preterm birth is not associated with an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage.
